Wheelo tips CAR by only 0.3pts (50.3%) — essentially a dead heat. Both teams rated poorly: NTH overall -14.6, CAR overall -12.4. CRITICAL: Rule 16 — Tristan Xerri SUSPENDED OUT (SC avg 131.7, #1 NTH ruckman). NTH's 96.0 PF avg and +10.0 clearance differential were generated WITH Xerri dominating. His loss deflates NTH's clearance advantage significantly. NTH bring in Jack Darling (experienced) and Zac Banch. Wheelo net impact: NTH -9.2 from changes vs CAR +6.2. CAR get back Adam Cerra, Nic Newman, Jordan Boyd, Wade Derksen — significant reinforcements. CAR's 73.7 PF avg is the worst of any team with a win, but 4 INS should lift output. Marvel Stadium minimal HGA (+1.4). Both local teams, no travel penalties. NTH 6-day break vs CAR 5-day break — negligible difference. NTH form 2-1 with +13.7 diff but inflated by Xerri. CAR form 1-2 but trending: defence tightening. Sam Walsh (SC 104) leads CAR mid. Harry Sheezel (SC 134.3) and Luke Parker (SC 121.7) lead NTH but lose Xerri ruck dominance. NTH ODELO at Marvel: net +5.5 (HIGH, 23 games). CAR ODELO away at Marvel: net +8.6 (HIGH, 14 games). Indoor venue — no weather factor. Footy Forecaster: CAR by 1 (50.4%) — agrees this is a coin flip. With Wheelo essentially dead even, Footy Forecaster dead even, and the top 2 accuracy-weighted Squiggle models both under 2pts for CAR, the true margin is much closer than the simple consensus suggests. I give NTH the edge based on: (1) NTH 2-1 vs CAR 1-2 current form, (2) even without Xerri, NTH's midfield (Sheezel 134 SC, Parker 122, LDU 115) outguns CAR's, (3) NTH home at Marvel with slight ODELO advantage, (4) CAR's 73.7 PF avg shows genuine scoring problems. NTH by 4.

BUT Wheelo tips PTA by 13.7 (65.8%) with PTA overall -13.9 vs RIC -28.9 — PTA clearly the better team on ratings. Footy Forecaster DISAGREES with everyone: tips RIC by 5 (54.4%). This is a massive red flag for PTA — when Footy Forecaster AND the top 2 Squiggle models all favour RIC, confidence in PTA must drop significantly. RIC 0-3 and catastrophic (58.0 PF avg, declining 71→60→43) but Rule 14 says regression to mean is real — they can't keep declining forever. RIC get back Nathan Broad, Samson Ryan (ruck), Kane McAuliffe, Liam Fawcett — Wheelo net impact +4.7. PTA get Ollie Wines RETURNING (experienced mid, SC avg not in top list but veteran presence) and Miles Bergman, Mitch Zadow — but Wheelo net impact -3.0 (losing Ratugolea etc). PTA still missing Connor Rozee (star, OUT 4+ weeks) and Ivan Soldo (knee, season). MCG HGA only +3.3 for RIC. PTA travel 654km (-1.5pts, short). RIC 7-day break vs PTA 6-day break — negligible. ODELO: RIC at MCG net +7.6 (HIGH, 28 games) — they lift at home. PTA at MCG net -56.4 BUT this is from only 4 games (MEDIUM reliability) and looks like an extreme outlier from 2024-25 data — flag as unreliable per Rule 18. PTA wildly volatile: 67, 133, 90. RIC H2H: PTA leads 7-3 in last 10 — Rule 6 compounds PTA edge by 20-30%. Weather: 14.4C, light rain 1.4mm, 9km/h wind S — minor scoring reduction. Tim Taranto (SC 119.3) RIC's best mid. Zak Butters (SC 118.3), JHF (SC 147 R2) lead PTA. Balancing: Rule 15 reduction + Rule 14 bounce + Footy Forecaster disagreement + top models favouring RIC vs Wheelo + H2H + PTA superior talent. Final: PTA still has better talent and Wheelo ratings, but this is much closer than the raw 8.3 consensus. PTA by 8 accounts for bounce-back and model disagreement while respecting PTA's superior midfield.
